# Bosch BMI270 Sensor API

This directory vendors the minimal BMI270 sources from Bosch Sensortec's
`BMI270_SensorAPI` repository at commit
`41129fcfe39c583ee5462d79195741945d51c1fe`.

Upstream: <https://github.com/boschsensortec/BMI270_SensorAPI>

The upstream BSD-3-Clause license is retained in `LICENSE`. Keep the commit and
license record updated whenever these files change.
